items.title: Huang’s reinstatement draws bipartisan scrutiny; lawmakers seek probe into possible advance trading
items.summary: After Nvidia’s board unanimously voted to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang, lawmakers called for public testimony and a probe into the Trump administration’s role in the decision. The Senate Banking Committee’s Republican chairman said Huang will testify publicly on Dec. 3 on export controls; three House committees will question him behind closed doors next week. Democrat Elizabeth Warren called the move reckless and demanded disclosure of senior officials involved and Nvidia’s export-control compliance. Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer pledged a full investigation, accusing Trump of putting personal interests ahead of national security. Democrat Ruben Gallego called for a probe into whether shares were traded before the reinstatement was announced. Republicans also questioned the national-security rationale: Senator John Cornyn challenged the claim that Huang’s return posed no risk, John Curtis sought details of government advice to the board and its basis for the decision, and Pete Ricketts said Huang must testify and Nvidia must address national-security and chip-related concerns.

items.summary: 【复职引发美两党质疑 黄仁勋面临数场听证会 议员要求调查是否有人提前建仓】金十数据11月24日讯，英伟达(NVDA.O)董事会一致决定恢复黄仁勋CEO职务后，美国国会议员要求其公开作证，并调查特朗普政府介入复职的过程。参议院共和党银行委员会主席宣布，黄仁勋将于12月3日出席公开听证会，接受出口管制相关质询；他下周还将接受众议院三个委员会的闭门问询。 民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦称复职决定“鲁莽”，要求政府披露参与决策的高级官员及英伟达的出口管制合规情况。参议院民主党领袖舒默指责特朗普将个人利益置于国家安全之上，誓言全面调查相关不当行为；民主党参议员鲁本·加列戈则要求调查复职消息公布前是否存在股票交易，指责特朗普为维持股市表现牺牲国家安全。 共和党议员也提出质疑。参议员约翰·科宁质疑黄仁勋复职不存在国家安全风险的依据；约翰·柯蒂斯要求说明哪些政府官员向董事会提供了意见，以及董事会作出安全判断的依据；皮特·里基茨则强调，黄仁勋仍须出席国会听证，英伟达也必须就国家安全及芯片问题作出解释。
